simple.meaning: תּוֹגַרְמָה (Tôwgarmâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Togarmah , a son of Gomer and his posterity.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תּוֹגַרְמָה (H8425) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 10:3, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תּוֹגַרְמָה (H8425) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תּוֹגַרְמָה (H8425) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תּוֹגַרְמָה (Tôwgarmâh) / H8425 is traced through Genesis 10:3, 1 Chronicles 1:6, Ezekiel 27:14, Ezekiel 38:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
